summary: Fix two confirmed release identity defects from v0.6.54 without changing the signed package gate or production services: exclude local build-control/description files from manifest and bind remote manifest/finalize to the immutable peeled tag commit.

components.owning_subsystem: GitHub Draft Release artifact identity and publication safety gate
components.disposition: Exclude hidden build-control files and generated Release body from local manifest. Resolve annotated/lightweight tag to its actual commit through GitHub commits/tag endpoint; never use moving Release.targetCommitish. Reject finalization when manifest commit differs from current tag commit, with zero Release mutation.
evidence: At v0.6.54 Draft, GitHub Release.targetCommitish is literally main while v0.6.54 peeled commit is 7ecc0c4e31c96fd83f5f0643484546dae65df78b.
The local dist/.gitignore is not in the GitHub Release upload asset list, but collect_local_facts previously included it.
components.verification_level: Offline self-check, targeted positive/negative regression tests, Ruff, independent managed GLM-5.3 Reviewer PASS/P0=0/P1=0 on exact frozen SHA, original full R9 exit 0, exact-SHA GitHub PR and push CI.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Reject missing/invalid tag resolution, mismatched manifest tag commit, absent signed macOS package, asset SHA mismatch, or missing platform. Do not publish Draft or mutate already tagged v0.6.54.
components.rollback_route: Revert this isolated three-path fix if review or tests fail; preserve existing v0.6.54 tag, Draft assets, Mac and Deepin production state.

components.disposition: Verify hidden/build-control exclusion, immutable tag SHA under moving main, fail-closed finalization for branch/moved tag, and GitHub tag SHA validation without network.
evidence: Targeted pytest and release_finalize.py --self-check must run offline.
components.verification_level: Targeted tests and original full R9.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Do not remove or weaken existing Release finalization safety checks.
components.rollback_route: Revert tests with this single-purpose release fix if required.

components.disposition: Declare all three changed paths and explicitly classify release-finalize control code.
evidence: Exact branch based on remote main 7ecc0c4e.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Fail closed if any changed path is missing or incorrectly classified.
components.rollback_route: Drop declaration together with the isolated code and test changes.

g1.necessity: Release.targetCommitish can equal moving main; a mutable identity or a hidden build-control file in the authoritative manifest can produce an unpublishable or misidentified release. Exact immutable tag and upload-asset set are mechanically verifiable safety facts.

g2.authority_owner: Existing repository release_finalize.py and GitHub annotated tag
g2.non_duplication: Reuse existing Draft/manifest/sha256/finalize gates and GitHub API; do not add a new publication authority, service or bypass.

g3.recovery_or_reason: When tag cannot resolve, return a fail-closed error without changing Draft. When manifest tag SHA mismatches, reject finalize with no edits; recover only through authorized manifest sync of the same immutable tag.

g4.rollback: Revert only this three-file isolated patch; existing v0.6.54 tag/Draft and Mac/Deepin production are untouched.
